name: Kanzaki Takenori
source: Serves as the Social Studies teacher. Also the advisor for the school's newspaper department. 55 years old. He is not good at socializing with people, and the only person he is close to is the science teacher, [url=/c136035]Aizawa Kaworu[/url].
